metaDescription: Deck Medic won Hamilton's 2026 Deck & Fence Staining award. See its four-step restoration process, Weather-Shield technology and 3-5 year finish.
summary: Deck Medic is a deck restoration and staining company serving Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto with a proprietary Weather-Shield process built for Canadian freeze-thaw cycles. The company's four-step method aims for finishes that resist peeling for three to five years.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Deck Medic offers deck staining and sealing, full-service deck restoration, power washing and deep cleaning, and fence staining and restoration, covering both the prep work and the final finish rather than just applying stain over existing wood. Structural restoration is included alongside cosmetic staining, and the service extends to fences, not decks alone, plus pergola treatments. The company describes its process as built specifically for the region's freeze-thaw conditions.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company follows a four-step process: assessment, deep power washing, mechanical sanding, and application of a premium penetrating stain, using proprietary Weather-Shield technology as the branded name for its overall approach. Mechanical sanding in particular is a more involved prep step than simple washing and is aimed at helping stain adhere and last three to five years rather than peeling within a season or two. This positions the company toward a more thorough, longer-lasting result over a quick spray-and-go job.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer said the sanding and prep work made all the difference, describing the finish as flawless and one that has held up beautifully. Another customer described the crew as punctual and tidy, saying the deck looks better than new and the stain colour was exactly what they wanted.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Deck Medic is based in Hamilton and serves Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. Homeowners outside this footprint should confirm coverage before booking.

strengths: Uses a four-step process including mechanical sanding, not just washing and staining.
Finishes are positioned to resist peeling for three to five years.
Covers full structural deck restoration, not only surface staining.
Also services fences and pergolas, not decks exclusively.
considerations: A more thorough four-step process likely costs more than a basic wash-and-stain service.
Mechanical sanding and full restoration take longer than a simple recoat, worth factoring into scheduling.
Best suited to decks needing real restoration rather than a quick colour refresh on already sound wood.
bestFor: Weathered or peeling decks needing full restoration
Homeowners wanting fence staining alongside deck work
Anyone wanting a finish expected to last three to five years
Pergola or gazebo staining paired with a deck project

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Deck Medic was selected as the top business in the Deck & Fence Staining category for Hamilton through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.
It is the company's branded four-step approach of assessment, deep power washing, mechanical sanding and a premium penetrating stain, built around resisting Canadian freeze-thaw conditions.
No. Fence staining and restoration is listed alongside deck services, so the company covers both structures.

faq.a: The company positions its process as producing finishes that resist peeling for three to five years, according to its listed service description.
